summary: Phase 9 (Admin per-project rate override + Earnings pay types) verified end-to-end. BACKEND: new /app/backend/tests/test_p9_rates.py (19 tests, all pass) exercises PUT /api/projects/{pid}/rates/{iid} happy path + rate_history + audit project.rate_overridden + installer notification kind=rate_changed; permission errors (employee 403, installer 403); validation errors (negative 422, unknown installer 404, not-assigned 400, daily-wage 400); earning follow-through (override before approval -> earning uses new rate; override after earned -> amount updated + overridden=true + amount_history appended; override after paid -> 409 + no change); two installers on one project have independent rates + exactly one earning each; /admin/payments.jobs[].overridden=True after override. rate_rows visibility: admin+employee receive project.rate_rows; installer response has NO rate_rows / NO rate_history / project.rates contains ONLY own id. Full regression `cd /app/backend && EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=... python -m pytest -o addopts='' tests/ -q` = 151 passed, 4 skipped (same four data-conditional skips as iteration 8: TestReviewNotifications::test_01 AI nondeterminism, TestP8EvidencePack::test_08 data-conditional on P419977, two test_p7_pdf_cleanup_merge migration tests data-conditional). 132 baseline + 19 new = 151. One run initially hit transient ConnectTimeouts to the preview URL; passed cleanly on re-run (same host-level transience documented in iteration 7/8). FRONTEND @ 390x844: admin -> /project/{TEST-P9DUAL} shows card testID=project-rates with 2 rows (rate-row-{A}, rate-row-{B}), each rate-value-{iid} rendered ('£400.00 per job · Earned, unpaid £400.00'), 2 Edit buttons rate-edit-{iid}; opening rate-sheet, filling rate-input=410 + rate-reason-input, pressing rate-save updates row text to '£410.00 per job · Earned, unpaid £410.00' + toast. Employee login on same project: 2 rows visible, 0 Edit buttons (admin-only enforced client-side AND server-side). Installer login: no project-rates card (hidden correctly). Admin -> /admin/settings payments list shows '(rate changed)' marker on overridden jobs (observed on TEST-P9DUAL-15A878 £410.00, TEST-P9A-* £320.00). Daily-wage row 'Daily wage · paid outside the app' + no edit path is covered in the component (tsx:131,134) and backend test TestRateOverrideErrors::test_06_daily_wage_installer_400 verifies the 400 server-side path. No React Native deprecations detected in P9 code paths (project/[id].tsx + admin/settings.tsx + src/projects.ts). No regressions.
action_items: Non-blocking: TestTwoInstallersIndependent sets installer B default_rate=180 for the shared-project test; main agent may want to clear it back to the pre-P9 default (installer B has no default_rate set in iteration 8). Not functionally impactful because per-project rates always drive earnings and are frozen at approval; the default is only used when a project has no override and no project-level rate. Harmless at 180.
Non-blocking (carried from iter 8): Pillow Image.getdata() deprecated for Pillow 14 (2027-10) in report_import.py:22,:35 - still emits warnings during P7 unit tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:619-651 override_rate: dependency admin() correctly 403s employee + installer; Pydantic RateIn(rate: float = Field(ge=0, le=100000)) delivers 422 for negative without touching DB; order of validation = installer-exists (404) -> installer-assigned (400) -> daily (400) -> paid-earning (409). Prevents info leakage e.g. the daily-wage 400 only fires after the 404/400-assignment checks (correct).

server.py:644-645 rate_history $push includes installer_id/old/new/reason/by/at and reason is normalised to None when blank/omitted - test_03_override_with_reason_persists confirmed by/at both populated.

server.py:646-648 updates amount AND amount_history on the existing earned record and sets overridden=true. Confirmed by TestOverrideFlowsIntoEarnings::test_02 (amount 275->320, hist last entry {old:275,new:320}).
server.py:599-601 installer branch of GET /projects/{pid} strips rate_history and filters rates to {own: value}; verified in TestRateRowsVisibility::test_02_staff_sees_rate_rows_installer_hidden.

server.py:607-616 rate_rows picks pay_type from users and earning from latest earnings record per installer_id - the dict comprehension on earns correctly produces one entry per installer_id (there is only one earning per installer per project by design).

server.py:1055 payments jobs include overridden=bool(e.get('overridden')) - verified in TestAdminPaymentsOverriddenFlag::test_01 and the frontend TEST-P9A-* / TEST-P9DUAL-* entries show '(rate changed)'.

project/[id].tsx:134 edit guard isAdmin && r.pay_type !== 'daily' && r.earning?.status !== 'paid' is strict (not loose), so paid earnings AND daily installers never render Edit (frontend employee/installer have 0 edit buttons - verified).
project/[id].tsx:131 daily row text is 'Daily wage · paid outside the app' - matches spec.
admin/settings.tsx:92 '(rate changed)' marker ONLY appears when j.overridden true - verified in the live payments list.

success_rate.backend: 100% - 151 passed, 4 data-conditional skips, 0 real failures (new P9 suite 19/19 pass)
success_rate.frontend: 100% - project-rates card + rate-sheet open/save + per-role gating + '(rate changed)' marker all verified at 390x844

seed_data_creation: test_p9_rates.py creates TEST-P9-*, TEST-P9A-*, TEST-P9DUAL-* projects (6-char uuid suffix each) via admin API. P419977 and EF-1024 untouched. TestOverrideFlowsIntoEarnings::test_03 marks one week of installer A earnings as paid on the TEST-P9A-* project it creates (expected - needed to prove the 409-when-paid path); this is TEST-tagged data only. The playwright run additionally overrode TEST-P9DUAL rate_row[0] to £410 via the UI (expected demonstration of save path). TestRestoreDemoInstaller::test_99 restores installer A to {default_rate:150, pay_type:per_job}. Installer B default_rate was set to 180 during the dual-installer test and not reverted (see Action Items).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run baseline: `cd /app/backend && EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://field-evidence-app-1.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest -o addopts='' tests/ -q`. Expect 151 passed, 4 skipped (same four data-conditional skips as iter 8). The P9 contract to protect: PUT /api/projects/{pid}/rates/{iid} must stay admin-only (not staff); must enforce the 404/400/400/409 validation ladder in that order; must atomically $set rates.{iid} AND $push rate_history on project AND, if an EARNED earning exists, $set amount/overridden AND $push amount_history on earning; must send kind=rate_changed to the installer and audit project.rate_overridden. GET /api/projects/{pid} for installer must NOT include rate_rows or rate_history, and project.rates must only contain the installer's own id. GET /api/admin/payments.jobs[].overridden must be bool(e.overridden). Frontend project/[id].tsx:134 edit guard must be isAdmin && pay_type!='daily' && earning.status!='paid'. If any P9 tests fail with ConnectTimeout, retry - preview URL is intermittently slow at ~10s connect.
rca_of_issue: N/A - phase 9 verified green end-to-end. The one UX friction noted during playwright exploration was that rate-save button sits below the Field keyboard on 390x844 and required scroll_into_view_if_needed to reach via Playwright. Real users hit it fine because the field tap scrolls the sheet, but a KeyboardAvoidingView wrap could tighten the mobile ergonomics; not a bug, just an observation.
